description: This file defines the PollyClient class for interacting with the Amazon Polly text-to-speech service, providing methods for various Polly operations and a method to create pre-signed URLs for speech synthesis.

classes.name: PollyClient
classes.description: A client class for the Amazon Polly service, extending AwsClient and providing methods for Polly operations including creating pre-signed URLs for speech synthesis.

methods.name: createSynthesizeSpeechPreSignedUrl
methods.description: Creates a pre-signed URL that can be used to perform the SynthesizeSpeech operation without requiring credentials for a limited time.
